entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider functions as a universal layer supporting multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to reduce token usage and latency, achieving significant task-completion gains in LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine built from text, code, and session history. It is designed for local operation, requiring Python 3.10 to 3.14 without the need for external LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction from video and code while offering byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This memory solution creates knowledge graphs with typed edges without requiring LLM calls, providing synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It is designed for multi-user company environments with scoped data access controls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a 'learn, retain, recall, and reflect' workflow for long-term agent memory. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, accessible via Docker, Kubernetes, or various language clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by using background reasoning to update peer representations from session history. It serves as the upstream library for self-hosted Hermes wrappers and integrates with frameworks like MCP and Claude Code.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider manages context trees using git-like versioning including commits, branches, and merges. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory operations for Hermes Agents. It features episodic compression and temporal recall with recency boosting, accessible via an MCP server or Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness improves agent performance on complex tasks through outcome-gated promotion of context changes based on verified trials. It generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and context bundles for Python and TypeScript environments.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise recovery of session details.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool retroactively indexes local session history from over 22 coding agents, including Claude Code and Cursor, to enable search across months of past activity. It provides cross-agent recall via MCP tools and CLI search while redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process for safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to maintain persistence across different sessions.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur provides a shared memory layer that stores human-readable YAML engrams locally for multi-agent systems. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context while supporting multi-project scoping to separate global, team, and project knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets across multiple clients, achieving 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It automates memory construction from sources like Discord and Obsidian, integrating directly with Hermes Agent and Claude Code via plugins.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates with agents through MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This SQLite-backed memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical schema and FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embedding models. The five-package family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows via WSL2.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context LLM inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result while tracking contradictions and managing memory hygiene. It can run as an embedded in-process execution or as an HTTP backend for clusters.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven CLI serves as a machine interface for maintaining source-grounded knowledge without requiring vector databases. It preserves citations and temporal data in portable archives that can be merged or imported between different stores.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that automates configuration for major coding agent clients using GGUF models.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide a purpose-built evidence packet for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to minimize prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to manage agent knowledge. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context updates for coding agents through hash-checked proposals and receipts. It provides a source-neutral migration path for chat and document exports across multiple supported agent platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a transparent audit trail of all prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log file.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys to facilitate direct stablecoin transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin routes agent queries to local skills, runbooks, and scripts using native search and neighbor traversal tools. It automatically generates routing notes through model calls to index and navigate local capabilities.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read durable memories from other connected agents. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer for caching and outbox syncing alongside semantic search capabilities.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It features configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing and vector storage for grounded Q&A and file reads.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This long-term memory solution secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage agent context.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information integrity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit focuses on memory hygiene through a file-based loop that uses a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without a database. It provides five slash commands for capture and recall, alongside 'rot' and 'lint' curators that identify stale or conflicting data to propose evidence-cited diffs.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for Hermes Agent. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4, utilizing the DeepSeek Harness for its agent runtime.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to bolster cybersecurity capabilities.

entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process. It features Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes with customizable professional, technical, or casual voice profiles.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and evolving skill sets collectively.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state directly within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,174 human-readable skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. Distributed under the MIT license, these skills are provided as markdown files ready for export to various AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform YouTube searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed via integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source code edits back into the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models for project handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service. It utilizes a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and recipes while implementing the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on stored work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and agent skills specifically localized in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard and offers a collection of skills formatted in SKILL.md.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable agent discovery and activation for blockchain operations. They support integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation prompting. It includes BFL API integration for managing tasks through polling and webhooks.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agent skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting these skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses four core verbs—infer, invoke, exec, and agent—to define intent as code. It maintains execution records and journals in a local traces directory and supports macOS and Linux environments.

entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face, operating autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye uses a five-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and hard triggers, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as a personal execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides both web and Android interfaces.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic scans from multiple security tools with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses three specialized agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are made.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and evidence-based verification gates for task decomposition. It includes a Python-based goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool loading and automates the registration of skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. it integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits from 2015 through 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and detects state drift during development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session health, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy while offering optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright for recording and ffmpeg for processing. It manages the entire workflow from rendering and compression to embedding the final optimized file into README markdown.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills via the remoteopenclaw.com database. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specifications to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose coverage gaps for AI agent skills. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, MSYS, and WSL environments. The tool ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies existing project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across protocols including Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and supports Hermes Agent and OpenClaw environments.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR on documents, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It utilizes macOS Vision for data extraction and includes an e-commerce material studio for structured content creation.

entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and managing boards, with payments distributed to dedicated wallets upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides structured web data from 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server featuring 191 distinct tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and other agent environments.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This toolkit provides pre-packaged blueprints and skills for lead enrichment, social data analysis, and web scraping. It supports multiple agent platforms including Hermes and Claude Code, offering integrated workspace Postgres and shareable dashboards for SEO and prospecting tasks.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes quality gates and semantic memory to align search results with user interests, producing structured briefings that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

It ensures point-in-time data integrity during backtesting and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports local Node.js installation or Docker deployment, offering memory browsing and MCP server integration for workflow management.

It provides a TUI and web dashboard for overseeing Git worktree management and multi-agent coordination.

entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes from single VPS agents to automated teams via a task bus delegation pattern. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It integrates with over 23 LLM providers and supports MCP tools to extend agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous tasks and a live stream of agent reasoning. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.

entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization tool automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena-style framework orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports cross-file resolution for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust, integrating with agents like Hermes via an MCP server.

entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art. Using YAML-based configurations, developers can apply diverse aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk styles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent commerce through Solana-based payments and identity registration using human-readable handles.

entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static analysis tool performs deterministic linting of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring runtime model execution. It identifies ambiguous descriptions and contract mismatches, integrating directly into CI workflows via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.

entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for API outages and provides tools for the management and retrieval of agent memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This Tauri 2-based manager provides a cross-platform interface for configuring and switching between Hermes Agent and other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one desktop controller for agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that features a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities for Hermes Agent. It enables 24/7 scheduled automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI or various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices without a complex build step. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This companion application simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single desktop environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This dashboard offers visual workflow building with human approval gates and scheduling for Hermes Agent tasks. It supports multi-platform channel configuration for services like Telegram and Slack, alongside analytics for tracking token costs and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager to provide a comprehensive development environment.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and Rust, featuring a specialized kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges active browser context with local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows users to switch between multi-agent profiles and use AI-assisted tab scoping to control the context sent to the agent.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for server workspaces and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, including custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features an MCP server control plane for lifecycle management and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs for Codex and Claude. It allows users to search local agent histories for prompts and tool calls, with support for resuming sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for ComfyUI and TTS, alongside a dynamic tool maker for runtime API integration.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for separating sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
